reviews.t: A Loyal Purchaser of this Product
reviews.x: The simple, ethically authentic ingredients are what led me to purchase this product from Cleopatra. This soap is as pure as it can get and it lathers like any other soap. Just a combination of Shea butter, coconut, and other organic ingredients are all I need to keep my skin looking and feeling smooth, glowing, youthful, and free of blemishes.  Thank you, Cleopatra, for your genuine manufacturing of this feel-good​ care-product.

I received this product free for my unbiased honest opinion.

reviews.t: It's a nice soap but I was hoping for more
reviews.x: I've been using this 2 times daily since I first received it at the end of October and have not seen much of a difference in the redness in my face (not sure what my facial redness and bumps are from - maybe some mild form of rosacea. It's definitely not acne though). My daughter also has been using it with similar results (she has mild, occasional acne). It's a nice soap but I was hoping for more.

This bar of soap is enormous! Such a good value! I love African black soap for my oily skin. It has some grit to it, so when I don't want to exfoliate my face I just rub the bar on my hands; alternatively, to exfoliate my face I rub the bar directly on it. Because the bar is so huge I cut off small chunks at a time so that it is a little easier to wield.

This is now the only soap I own. I cut about 5 bars off the original 12 oz chunk and store what I am not using. One 12oz chunk lasts me nearly 8 months. I use the soap to wash my body and hair. I find that my hair is a bit "sticky" when wet, but dries beautifully. The soap can be drying, so I use coconut oil or shea butter after my shower.

claims.text: Many reviewers love this soap and say it leaves their skin feeling soft and clean.
Several reviewers with sensitive or acne-prone skin report it clears breakouts and works well for them.
Some reviewers say the soap burns or irritates their face, especially around the eyes.
A few reviewers report seeing no real change or difference after using it.
Some reviewers note the bar gets soft, mushy, or crumbly and doesn't lather long enough.
